description: Redox potential number line with the measured E. coli cytoplasmic value, and Cys17/Cys80 census across 96 AcrIIC1 homologs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
res=pd.read_csv("acrIIC1_entrez_cys_census.csv")
nonid=res[res.pct_id<99.9]
n_both=int(((nonid.p17=="C")&(nonid.p80=="C")).sum())
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,5.8))

axA=fig.add_subplot(1,2,1)
axA.axhline(0,color="k",lw=1.2)
pts=[(-80,"NmDsbA1/2/3 E°' (periplasm)\nPMID 19631659","#b2182b",1),
     (-228,"E. coli periplasm WT, roGFP-iL\nPMID 37413765","#ef8a62",-1),
     (-243,"E. coli periplasm ΔdsbA\nPMID 37413765","#ef8a62",1),
     (-262,"Mtb TrxB E°'\nPMID 18723612","#67a9cf",-1),
     (-314.4,"E. coli CYTOPLASM, Grx1-roGFP2\n−314.4 mV (99% CI −313.8/−315.1)\nPMID 39689618","#2166ac",1)]
for v,lab,c,side in pts:
    axA.plot([v],[0],"o",ms=10,color=c,zorder=3)
    axA.annotate(lab,(v,0),xytext=(v,0.34*side),ha="center",
                 va="bottom" if side>0 else "top",fontsize=7.4,color=c,
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-",color=c,lw=0.8))
axA.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-260,-0.06),60,0.12,color="#999999",alpha=0.45))
axA.text(-230,-0.16,"−260 to −200 mV: range Zhao et al. 2022 assumed\nfor 'normal cytoplasm' (cited to two eukaryotic reviews)",
         ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.2,color="#444444")
axA.annotate("AcrIIC1 C17–C80 switch E°':\nNEVER MEASURED",(-150,0.04),xytext=(-150,0.62),
             ha="center",fontsize=9.5,color="red",fontweight="bold",
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color="red",lw=1.4,ls="--"))
axA.set_xlim(-345,-50); axA.set_ylim(-0.95,0.9); axA.set_yticks([])
axA.set_xlabel("standard / measured redox potential at pH 7 (mV)")
axA.set_title("A  Only one of the two numbers exists",loc="left",fontsize=11)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: axA.spines[s].set_visible(False)

axB=fig.add_subplot(1,2,2)
sub=nonid.sort_values("pct_id",ascending=False).head(26)
y=np.arange(len(sub))[::-1]
for col,x in [("p17",0),("p80",1)]:
    v=sub[col].values
    axB.scatter([x]*len(sub),y,s=165,marker="s",
        c=["#1a9850" if a=="C" else ("#d9d9d9" if a=="-" else "#d73027") for a in v],
        edgecolors="white",linewidths=1.1)
axB.scatter(np.full(len(sub),2.6),y,s=155,marker="o",
    c=["#1a9850" if n>=2 else "#d73027" for n in sub.nCys],edgecolors="white",linewidths=1.1)
for yy,(_,r) in zip(y,sub.iterrows()):
    axB.text(3.4,yy,f"{r.pct_id:.0f}% id   nCys={int(r.nCys)}",va="center",fontsize=6.6,color="#333333")
axB.set_yticks(y); axB.set_yticklabels([f"{a}  {str(o)[:23]}" for a,o in zip(sub.acc,sub.org)],fontsize=6.3)
axB.set_xticks([0,1,2.6]); axB.set_xticklabels(["Cys17","Cys80","≥2 Cys\nin protein"],fontsize=8)
axB.set_xlim(-0.6,6.2)
axB.set_title(f"B  Both cysteines kept in {n_both}/{len(nonid)} AcrIIC1 homologs;\n     {int((res.nCys<2).sum())}/{len(res)} carry fewer than two Cys in total\n     (green kept, red substituted, grey gap)",loc="left",fontsize=10)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: axB.spines[s].set_visible(False)
axB.tick_params(left=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("both Cys retained among non-identical:",n_both,"/",len(nonid))
